title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $700 on roborock Qrevo CurvX
content_html:
SAVE $700: As of Sept. 8, the Roborock Qrevo CurvX is on sale for $799.99 at Amazon. That's a 47% discount on the list price.

Credit: roborock

$799.99 at Amazon
$1,499.99 Save $700

Tired of dragging the vacuum around yourself? Then it's time for a robot vacuum. And as of Sept. 8, there's a great deal on the Roborock Qrevo CurvX to make the switch easier. Down $700 to $799.99, it packs 22,000Pa HyperForce suction and a Zero-Tangling Design to tackle dirt, carpet debris, and pet and long hair up to 40cm. It also mops, taking another chore off your hands.

It has a compact design, meaning it can easily get into those awkward spaces beneath sofas, cabinets, and other low furniture where dust and dirt tend to build up. And for navigation, it combines the RetractSense Navigation System and LiDAR sensors with Reactive AI Obstacle Recognition, using structured light and an RGB camera to identify and avoid up to 108 object types as it moves around your home.

It's also well-equipped to handle dirt and excess hair from your pets. In addition to extra cleaning capabilities, it has features such as pet recognition to help it avoid getting too close, video calling, and two-way voice interaction that let you check in on your pets and see what they're up to while you're away.
